name: The Japa Dream
story: 38% of her income is family rallying behind her. Proof-of-funds means the money must sit still in the account — so her dream line stays low while her savings do the real work.
caveat: Her 'dream progress' looks tiny (19.4%) only because the target — a full exit — is enormous relative to a teller's salary. Read her savings, not her dream spend.
